Hi folks,

Thank you very much!

Angela C.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: additional metadata
parts:
Dear Angela,
what did you try to do, with which functions? If you share your code I'll be able to point you in the right direction. Normally, extracting this type of metadata is straightforward in camtrapR.

You can use the functions exifTagNames to find metadata and recordTable to tabulate records (see argument additionalMetadataTags).
Best regards,
Jürgen
